selected_candidate.title: Mac Classic II System 7-5-5
selected_candidate.description_as_published: A 4MB Macintosh Classic II running classic MacOS System 7.5.5
selected_candidate.structured_data_caption: An Apple Macintosh Classic II running System 7.5.5

creator.name: RetroEditor
creator.kind: Wikimedia Commons user; real-world identity not stated on the file page

selected_candidate.publication_date_evidence: Commons upload log: 'Uploaded own work with UploadWizard' by RetroEditor, revision 781746898
selected_candidate.depicted_event_note: A modern (2019) photograph of vintage hardware running vintage software. It is NOT a period 1990s photograph. The software shown is a 1996 release; the hardware model was sold 1991-1993.

acquisition.method: Anonymous HTTPS GET of the original file with curl 8.18.0. No account, login, payment, terms click-through, CAPTCHA, or gated route.
acquisition.first_attempt: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests from upload.wikimedia.org (rate limit). Retried once, spaced, with a descriptive User-Agent; HTTP 200.

embedded_metadata.note: The uploaded file is smaller than the camera's native frame and was saved through GIMP on upload day, so the uploader cropped and/or processed it before upload. The exact edits are not documented. No sign of on-screen compositing was observed at 1:1, but this is visual inspection, not forensic proof.

version_model_evidence.evidence: On-screen 'About This Macintosh' window reads 'System Software 7.5.5' and '(c) Apple Computer, Inc. 1983-1995' (legible in source/original.jpg at 1:1). The uploader's description independently states System 7.5.5.

version_model_evidence.claim: Hardware is a Macintosh Classic II
version_model_evidence.evidence: Case badge 'Macintosh Classic II' is visible in the photograph. Apple Support 'Macintosh Classic II: Technical Specifications' (https://support.apple.com/en-us/112201) lists 7.5.5 among supported system versions. Snapshot: evidence/source-page/apple-support-112201-classic-ii-specs.html.
Menu bar shows the Apple menu glyph, File, Edit, View, Label, Special (Finder menus), Help and Application menu icons; a Finder window titled 'Utilities'; the Trash on the desktop.

TidBITS, 'Apple Releases System 7.5.5 Update', Geoff Duncan, published 1996-09-23 (https://tidbits.com/1996/09/23/apple-releases-system-7-5-5-update/). Snapshot: evidence/source-page/tidbits-1996-09-23-system-7-5-5.html.

selected_candidate.transformations_to_original: None. source/original.jpg is byte-identical to the Commons original.

derivatives.transform: Uniform Lanczos downscale x0.685714 to 989x1080, centered pillarbox on #111318 at x=465..1454. No crop, stretch, retouch, watermark removal, text, or UI added.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
license.covers: The photograph as the photographer's work. It cannot license Apple's copyrighted software interface shown on the screen. See evidence/rights.json.

selected_candidate.rights_status: unresolved: photograph is file-specifically licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the depicted Apple System 7.5.5 Finder interface is not covered by that license and needs rights review
selected_candidate.credit_text: Photo: RetroEditor / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Resized and pillarboxed. Apple, Macintosh, and Mac OS are trademarks of Apple Inc.

license_history_check.result: The 2023-07-16 capture (one week after upload) shows the same description, date 6 July 2019, source 'Own work', author RetroEditor, and CC BY-SA 4.0. No deletion or copyright-violation notice.

selected_candidate.uploader_consistency_check: RetroEditor's Commons uploads include other own photographs of the same hardware family uploaded the day before, e.g. 'Inside_an_Apple_Macintosh_Classic_II.jpg' and 'Apple_Macintosh_Classic_II_Main_Board.jpg' (2023-07-08), and 'Welcome_To_Macintosh.jpg' (2023-07-09). Consistent with a genuine own-work collection; not proof of authorship.

candidates_considered.title: File:System_7_macintosh.jpg
candidates_considered.creator: Nikopol-h (Commons user)
candidates_considered.content: Full-screen capture, teal desktop, Finder menu bar, About This Macintosh reading 'System Software 7.5.3 Revision 2'; disk named 'Mac OS 7.5.3'; 262,144K RAM.
candidates_considered.deficiencies: A direct screenshot of Apple's software: the uploader's CC0 cannot waive Apple's copyright, and Commons policy (Commons:Screenshots) bars screenshots of non-free software, so this file is at risk of deletion. The memory figure suggests an emulator, and the description has no subversion or date. Not downloaded into the asset; inspected only.

candidates_considered.title: File:System_7.5.5_Update_Apple_-_Macintosh.jpg
candidates_considered.creator: Nikopol-h (Commons user)
candidates_considered.content: Three System 7.5.5 Update install floppy disks.
candidates_considered.deficiencies: No desktop, Apple menu, or Finder, so it fails the ticket's core requirement. Useful only as supporting B-roll. Not downloaded into the asset; inspected only.
